10,000 hours. How much of the gap between people does practice actually explain? Have a number before you look — 12%, across 88 studies (Macnamara, Hambrick & Oswald, 2014, Psychological Science). Comment your number. I'll know if you peeked. Find out how you learn → link in bio.

You learn it today and want it still there in a year. One review: A, tomorrow — or B, in three weeks? It's B, by a distance (Cepeda, Vul, Rohrer, Wixted & Pashler, 2008, Psychological Science — 1,354 people). Comment A or B. I already know what you picked. Find out how you learn → link in bio.

Find the nodules on the scan. 20 of 24 radiologists missed the gorilla sitting in the corner of it — and most of them looked straight at it (Drew, Võ & Wolfe, 2013, Psychological Science). Comment your count. I already know what you missed. Find out how you learn → link in bio.
